_comment: Real-world-style incidents used to seed and demo Aegis Measure.

suites.name: fabric-and-care
suites.description: Fabric and care questions — the saree category where quality first quietly degraded.

cases.question: What fabric is the Rajasthani block-print saree (SKU BPS-2214), and what does it need for care?
cases.context: SKU BPS-2214 — Rajasthani block-print saree. Fabric: pure mulberry silk. Care: dry clean only. Do not machine wash or hand wash; both can damage the fabric and the block-print dye.
cases.reference_answer: Pure mulberry silk — dry clean only. Do not machine wash or hand wash; both can damage the fabric and the block-print dye.

cases.question: Does the indigo block-print saree (SKU BPS-2231) need dry cleaning, or can I hand-wash it in cold water?
cases.context: SKU BPS-2231 — Indigo block-print saree. Fabric: pure mulberry silk. Care: dry clean only. Hand-washing, even in cold water, will damage this piece.
cases.reference_answer: Dry clean only — pure silk. Hand-washing, even in cold water, will damage this piece.

suites.name: dupatta-care
suites.description: The incident that exposed the component-check blind spot — a retrieval bug substituting a near-duplicate dupatta's listing.

cases.question: Does the teal cotton dupatta (SKU DUP-3390) need hand washing, or is machine-wash fine?
cases.context: SKU DUP-3390 — Teal cotton dupatta. Fabric: cotton with reactive dye. Care: hand-wash separately, colour may run. Do not machine wash with other items.
cases.reference_answer: Hand-wash separately — colour may run. Do not machine wash with other items.

suites.name: footwear-sizing
suites.description: The footwear catalog restructuring that a deploy-only trigger couldn't catch — the case for a fixed-interval schedule.

cases.question: Does the standard-fit running shoe (SKU FTW-1187) come in half sizes?
cases.context: SKU FTW-1187 — Running shoes, standard fit. Sizing: full sizes only (no half sizes stocked for this model).
cases.reference_answer: No — this model (FTW-1187) is stocked in full sizes only, no half sizes.

suites.name: festive-sale-bundle-policy
suites.description: Sale-weekend policy questions that the fabric-and-care rubric had no concept of — verified directly by the policy owner, run hourly during the sale window.

cases.question: Can I use my festive sale coupon on top of the three-item bundle discount?
cases.context: Festive sale terms: the three-item bundle discount cannot be combined with any festive sale coupon code — coupons and bundle pricing do not stack.
cases.reference_answer: No — coupons and the bundle discount cannot be combined; only one applies per order.

cases.question: What does the gift-wrap add-on include?
cases.context: Gift wrap add-on costs a flat fee per bundle and covers wrapping paper, ribbon, and a printed gift tag; it does not include a greeting card.
cases.reference_answer: Wrapping paper, ribbon, and a printed gift tag for a flat fee per bundle. It does not include a greeting card.

suites.name: chennai-regional-sizing
suites.description: A beta-tester catch — the one disclosed gap (children's sizing) the team launched with open eyes instead of guessing.

cases.question: Is the regional size chart the same numbering for adult and children's kurtas?
cases.context: Regional children's size conversion table (kurtas): children's regional sizing uses an entirely separate numbering scheme from the adult regional chart — a children's size number does not correspond to the same number on the adult scale.
cases.reference_answer: No — children's regional sizing uses a completely separate numbering scheme from the adult chart; the same number means something different on each.

declared_gaps: Children's sizing not covered in the initial 12-case beta set — extend once real beta feedback comes in.
